name: Guangdong Kingstrong Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Kingstrong Technology Co., Ltd. operates as a key participant in the advanced materials industry, with its market reach extending across both China and international territories. The company's diverse product range includes various electronic and RF (radio frequency) components such as power amplifier and filter modules, launch components, power add-ons, frequency hopping filter components, TR components, switch co-site filtering components, and solid-state transmitters. Additionally, their offerings encompass cutting-edge materials like thermal barrier coatings, carbon fiber products, absorbing materials, and photoelectric products. Established in 1998, the company was initially known as King-Strong New Material Technology Co., Ltd. before adopting its current name, Guangdong Kingstrong Technology Co., Ltd., in October 2021. Its corporate headquarters are situated in Foshan, China.
